name: HS Min Max Quantity for WooCommerce
author: hookspark

sections.description:
HS Min Max Quantity for WooCommerce lets you set a WooCommerce minimum order quantity, maximum purchase quantities, quantity multiples and minimum or maximum order amounts. Apply purchase rules to products, variations, categories or the whole cart, with clear customer messages.

All included features are free. No premium upgrade, license key or external service account is required.

Plugin website | Documentation | Support forum

Features — all included features are free

  • Minimum and maximum quantity per product.
  • Quantity limits for product variations.
  • Minimum and maximum order quantity for the cart.
  • Quantity limits for groups of matching products.
  • Quantity limits by product category, tag or global attribute.
  • Quantity steps and multiples: sell in pairs or packs of six.
  • Minimum and maximum purchase amounts for products, matching groups or the cart.
  • Purchase rules by customer role, including guests and logged-in customers.
  • Exclusions: exempt products/customers or exclude products from counting.
  • Custom customer messages explaining purchase limits.

Optional AI configuration proposals

The shared HookSpark AI access switch is off by default. With WordPress 6.9 or later, the official WordPress MCP Adapter installed separately and a compatible AI client, an authorized store operator can read supported settings and prepare a Min/Max rule proposal. Review and approve the proposal in WordPress before it changes saved configuration. Proposals expire after 15 minutes and are rejected if the saved configuration has changed or the proposal has already been applied.

The connection uses the site endpoint and the WordPress account permissions. It does not grant general administration, customer/order access or payment control. You choose your client and connection credentials; any configuration you share with that client is subject to its provider’s terms and privacy policy. The plugin does not choose an external AI service or send configuration to one automatically. The normal rule editor remains available without this integration.

Setup and supported scope: https://hookspark.dev/documentation/ai-access/

Try the storefront and admin demos

Live storefront demo | Try the admin demo
Explore six examples and a personal 60-minute admin workspace. Use fictional details; no real payments or external emails.

Minimum order quantity and maximum quantity per product

Require at least 6 units or cap purchases at 12. Rules count products separately or combine eligible units in a group/cart.

Sell in packs with quantity steps and multiples

For packs of 6, set minimum and multiple to 6: allow 6, 12 and 18. A minimum alone also allows 7 or 8. Starting quantity suggests the first selection. Pack rules do not create bundles or discounts.

Minimum order amount and maximum order value

Set a minimum or maximum purchase value, such as 50 in your store currency. Choose tax and discount basis; cart checks can include shipping and fees. Amount rules check value, quantity rules count units.

Privacy and optional AI access

The plugin does not include telemetry, automatic diagnostic uploads or a built-in external AI service. Rules and custom messages are stored in your WordPress database. Customer targeting can store WordPress user IDs and role names; configuration exports can contain these identifiers, hashed user bindings, product references and merchant-entered text. Treat exports as private store configuration.

AI access is disabled by default. A site administrator must enable it, and each requesting WordPress user must have shop-management permission. If you connect a separate MCP adapter and AI client, that client can read rule configuration, including targeting identifiers and custom text. Review your chosen adapter/client’s permissions, privacy policy and terms before connecting it. No external provider account is required to use Min/Max. Proposed changes are held temporarily for review by the same WordPress user; the AI tools do not directly approve changes.

Diagnostics are generated locally and omit site URLs, filesystem paths, user identities, orders, rule names and custom messages. You decide whether to download and share them. Saved configuration is retained when the plugin is removed, as described below.

Compatibility with WooCommerce and plugin integrations

  • HS Dynamic Pricing & Discounts: promotion previews can show Min/Max restrictions; amount rules can use a before-Pricing basis. Pricing is optional.
  • WooCommerce: classic cart/checkout, variations and HPOS have local test evidence. Selected Cart/Checkout Blocks and Store API flows have been checked; this is not a claim of compatibility with every flow or extension.

Requirements and boundaries

Requires WooCommerce 10.6 or later, WordPress 6.8 or later and PHP 8.2 or later. Native lifecycle checks cover WP 6.8 / Woo 10.6.0 and WP 7.1 / Woo 11.1.0 on PHP 8.2.29. Observe WooCommerce’s own WordPress requirements. Other PHP branches and every intermediate combination have not been verified.

Elementor, Avada and other untested third-party stacks are not declared compatible. Only whole quantities are supported; decimal quantities, weight limits and lifetime customer purchase limits are not implemented.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce on a staging site.
  2. Upload this plugin ZIP using Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  3. Open Settings from the plugin row or HookSpark > Min/Max.
  4. Create a rule, review its preview and enable it when the configuration is correct.
  5. Test the product, cart quantity updates and checkout with representative customers before enabling it on a live store.

For earlier Plugin Lab builds, deactivate the old copy before installing this package. Saved keys are retained; never activate both copies.
sections.faq:
How do I set a minimum order quantity per product in WooCommerce?

Target the product with a quantity rule, set its minimum, review and enable it. A minimum of 6 with no multiple allows 7 or 8 too, subject to stock and other rules.

Can I limit the maximum quantity per product?

Yes. Set a maximum on a product rule. It applies to the current purchase, not lifetime customer purchases.

How do I sell in packs of 6 or in pairs?

Set minimum and quantity multiple to 6 for packs of 6, or to 2 for pairs. Starting quantity suggests the first selection.

Can I set a minimum order amount?

Yes. Use a cart amount rule with your chosen tax and discount basis. A minimum of 50 means 50 in your store currency. Choose whether shipping and fees count.

Can categories or variations share a minimum quantity?

Use a matching group with combined counting. A rule directly targeting a variable product applies to each variation. Explicit variation exceptions replace only the selected parent rule.

Can wholesale customers have different minimum quantities?

Yes. Target an existing customer role. The plugin does not create roles or wholesale prices.

Is a paid upgrade required?

No. All included features are free, without a license key or external service account.

What happens when several rules match?

All applicable rules must be satisfied. Test overlaps and available stock before enabling rules.

Will removal delete my settings?

No. Deactivation stops enforcement and retains configuration. Removing and reinstalling the current package retains saved rules. Keep a database backup and configuration export before updates. A rollback across a schema change may require restoring both code and its matching database backup.

A rule prevents customers from checking out. What should I check?

Check all matching product, variation, group and cart rules, together with available stock and any other quantity-limiting extensions. Disable the affected rule while you correct its configuration and test as both a guest and the targeted customer. Deactivating Min/Max stops its checks without deleting saved rules. Avoid enabling competing quantity engines without testing their combined behavior.

How should I report a security issue?

Email info@hookspark.dev privately with the affected version and steps to reproduce. Do not post passwords, access tokens, customer data or exploitable security details in public support discussions.

How are translations provided?

This directory package uses WordPress.org language packs and does not bundle translation files. Availability depends on translations being approved and released through translate.wordpress.org. Your WordPress profile language controls the admin interface; the site language controls storefront messages. Merchant-entered rule names and custom messages are not automatically translated.
sections.changelog:
0.13.0

  • Add optional WordPress Abilities for reading supported Min/Max configuration and preparing bounded rule proposals.
  • Add the shared HookSpark AI access switch and review/approval controls in WordPress. Proposals retain account permissions, expire after 15 minutes and reject stale or repeated changes.
  • Keep the manual rule editor and ordinary operation available without an AI client or MCP Adapter.

0.12.2

  • 2026-10-06: Added packaged documentation of selected local WPML and Astra compatibility checks. Exact tested versions and limits are recorded at https://hookspark.dev/min-max-quantities/#compatibility; this is not certification of every configuration.

0.12.1

  • Use the distinctive HookSpark Min Max Quantities name and matching directory translation domain.
  • Use WordPress.org automatic language packs instead of bundled translations and manual loading.
  • Show all ten HookSpark product families with direct product-page links and matching icons.
  • Recognize the Min/Max directory package and the separate Side Cart/Checkout Customizer Free packages when opening settings.
  • Update catalog text, author/contributor information, privacy notes and the bundled license.

0.12.0

  • Add the before-Pricing amount basis and quantity/amount preview integration while retaining standalone operation.
  • Include product and customer targeting, category/tag exclusions, rule previews and reviewed configuration imports.
  • Verify installation, updates and retained rules at the documented platform endpoints.
  • Guard optional AI category registration when the Abilities API is unavailable.
  • Align the package folder and translation domain with the assigned WordPress.org slug, hookspark-min-max-quantities-for-woocommerce, while preserving existing configuration keys.
